title: Recovered bit from a circuit encoding
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word and let $j$ be a natural number with $j<|x|$. The bit indicating whether the pair encoding of the index description for $(|x|,j)$ followed by $x$ belongs to the language of well-formed fan-in-two Boolean circuits that evaluate to true is exactly the $j$th bit of $x$.
